name: mdweb
description: Simple markdown viewer — terminal + web. RFC-style monospace, 72-col width.

scripts.build: bun build --compile src/main.ts --outfile mdweb && node scripts/postbuild.mjs mdweb
scripts.build:macos-arm64: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile mdweb-darwin-arm64 && node scripts/postbuild.mjs mdweb-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:macos-x64: bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/main.ts --outfile mdweb-darwin-x64 && node scripts/postbuild.mjs mdweb-darwin-x64
